title: Make It Think + Your Midterm
subtitle: Wednesday: the same loop, the same tools, one paragraph — and your agent plans before it acts. Monday: one agent or many, what MCP actually is, and the midterm project assigned with a plan on paper before you leave.
heroTitle: Make It Think

objectives.title: Make It Think · Read Its Thinking · Price Its Thinking
objectives.description: The one outcome of Wednesday: turn any tool-using agent into one that reasons before it acts with a single paragraph, read its THOUGHT trace as an audit, and put a dollar figure on the reasoning so you can say which questions deserve it, and on which brain.

objectives.title: Turn a Lookup Bot into a Researcher
objectives.description: ReAct: think, act, observe, repeat. One paragraph of system prompt, zero changes to the loop. Run the same question at three levels and read the agent's thoughts.

objectives.title: Price the Thinking
objectives.description: Steps, tool calls, thinking tokens, dollars. ReAct is several times more expensive than a plain loop, so deciding which questions deserve it is a business decision you can now make with numbers.

objectives.title: Decide One Agent or Many
objectives.description: Pipeline, orchestrator, debate, and the rule that more agents is not more intelligence. Split only for a reason you can name: permissions, specialization, context isolation, parallelism. Plus MCP, and why a protocol is not a permission.

objectives.title: Start Your Midterm with a Plan
objectives.description: Your bot, for a real problem: one user, two tools with one real API, the trust layer, five tests, one honest page. Assigned Wednesday, kicked off on paper in class, due Mon Nov 2.

agenda.title: Meeting 1 · HW #6 Pulse + This Week's News + The Pattern Gap
agenda.description: Who texted your bot, and did it ever go looking before it answered? Then Gemini 4 Argon, released yesterday, as a Level 2 somebody else trained. Then: your bot answers the first thing it can, and a researcher plans first.
bulletPoints: You first: a volunteer answers the job question in five seconds, then the room says how they would actually find out. That list is a THINK line. You already do this
Three levels of the same agent: the model alone, your Session 4 loop, ReAct
This week: Gemini 4 Argon (Oct 13) — 1M output tokens of room to think, $2/$10 per million, not on the free tier. One line swaps the brain; the paragraph is still yours
The paragraph: THINK before every call, OBSERVE after, and never invent when a tool says 'no results'
Nobody touched the loop. The loop can't tell the difference. The model can

agenda.title: Live, Then Hands-On: Same Question, Three Times
agenda.description: 'I graduate in May 2027. Is AI going to eliminate the analyst jobs I'm applying for?' at levels 0, 1, and 2 on the projector, then on your own key. Count the hops, read the thoughts, run the bill.
bulletPoints: Only your Gemini key today — tools are calculator, the job board, and real Wikipedia
Bet before Level 2 runs: how many hops, how many times the cost. The bill cell prints your guess vs reality
The bill table: steps, tool calls, thinking tokens, dollars on Flash and on Argon — how many times more did thinking cost, and on which brain?
Stop at Part 5; we break it together — then Part 6 is a question you actually have this month, plain vs ReAct, both bills

agenda.description: A company that does not exist, an opinion dressed as research, and a calculator question with ReAct on.

activities.discussionNote: The plan is where midterms are won. Code is the easy part now.

takeaways.text: Reasoning is a paragraph, not a model upgrade. Think, act, observe, repeat. The loop never changed; the behavior did.

Thinking has a price — and a brain is a line item. ReAct costs several times a plain loop; the same run on Gemini 4 Argon costs several times more again. Route research to it and lookups around it. That routing is a business decision.
The fix for a confident fake is in the tool. A tool that says 'no results' plus a prompt that forbids filling the gap. You wrote both.
More agents is not more intelligence. Start with one. Split only for a reason you can name: permissions, specialization, isolation, parallelism.
A protocol is not a permission. MCP standardizes the plug. It does not open the door.
